t: 在伦巴第贵族帕维亚的集会上,伊夫雷亚的阿都因被恢复了领地并加冕为意大利国王.
te: At an assembly at Pavia of Lombard nobles, Arduin of Ivrea is restored to his domains and crowned King of Italy.
dz: 在伦巴第贵族帕维亚的集会上,伊夫雷亚的阿都因被恢复了领地并加冕为意大利国王.
de: At an assembly at Pavia of Lombard nobles, Arduin of Ivrea is restored to his domains and crowned King of Italy.

t: 亨利二世是皇帝奥托三世的堂兄弟,当选并加冕为德国国王.
te: Henry II, a cousin of Emperor Otto III, is elected and crowned King of Germany.
dz: 亨利二世是皇帝奥托三世的堂兄弟,当选并加冕为德国国王.
de: Henry II, a cousin of Emperor Otto III, is elected and crowned King of Germany.

t: 英国国王"瑟勒德二世"下令杀害所有在英国的丹麦人,今天被称为"圣布里斯节大屠杀".
te: English king Æthelred II orders the killing of all Danes in England, known today as the St. Brice's Day massacre.
dz: 英国国王"瑟勒德二世"下令杀害所有在英国的丹麦人,今天被称为"圣布里斯节大屠杀".
de: English king Æthelred II orders the killing of all Danes in England, known today as the St. Brice's Day massacre.
